summary: Defence, Pharma, and Capital Goods lead breakouts as Nifty consolidates near 23,650 — BrahMos Vietnam deal, rupee tailwind for exporters, and infra capex push converge on three sector-leading momentum setups.
market_context: Nifty 50 closed at 23,659 on May 22 — recovering through the week with sector rotation favouring defence (BrahMos Vietnam ~₹6,000 cr deal), pharma (Nifty Pharma at fresh record on rupee weakness and defensive flows) and capital goods (₹11.21 lakh crore Budget infra capex). FII selling has moderated while SIP inflows of ₹321 bn/month continue supporting mid/smallcap leadership. IT also rebounded 3-4% off long-term trendline support, broadening market breadth. Volume-backed individual breakouts are outperforming the index — a textbook environment for tactical 2-week momentum trades.

stocks.name: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Ltd
stocks.thesis: Breaking out of a 3-week consolidation on the BrahMos Vietnam ~₹6,000 crore deal news, with 10% move from ₹2,451 to ₹2,704 in five sessions and weekly MACD turning mildly bullish.

technical.pattern: Bollinger Band Squeeze Breakout from Consolidation
technical.trend: Bullish — weekly Bollinger Bands mildly bullish, daily MACD curling up
technical.volume_signal: 1.8x average on the breakout candle post Vietnam deal news
points: Cleared multi-week resistance at ₹2,650 on Vietnam deal news
RSI at 61 — momentum building without overbought conditions
Weekly Bollinger squeeze resolution favours upside continuation

fundamental.catalyst: BrahMos missile deal with Vietnam (~₹6,000 cr) in focus; Defence Minister's outreach to Vietnam and South Korea driving fresh export visibility
points: Sole Indian builder of submarines, frigates and destroyers — strong order pipeline
Defence shipbuilding sector growing 12-18% annually with indigenisation mandate
FY27 defence budget ₹6.81 lakh crore (+9.5% YoY) supports execution runway

stocks.risk: If price closes back below ₹2,450 (recent breakout base), the momentum setup invalidates. ICICI Direct's longer-term target ₹3,060 implies multi-week consolidation if profit-booking kicks in near ₹2,800.
